name: observable
description: Implement a reactive Observable pattern with subscribe, map, and filter operators

promptLevels.intermediate: implement an Observable with subscribe that can emit values over time
promptLevels.advanced: create an Observable class with subscribe, map, filter operators and proper unsubscribe handling
promptLevels.expert: Implement an `Observable<T>` class with: a constructor taking a subscriber function `(observer: Observer<T>) => Unsubscribe`, `subscribe(observer: Observer<T>): Unsubscribe` method, `map<U>(fn: (value: T) => U): Observable<U>` operator, and `filter(predicate: (value: T) => boolean): Observable<T>` operator. Observer has next, error, and complete callbacks. {languageSpecific}

languageInstructions.typescript: Use TypeScript with generics for type safety. Define Observer and Unsubscribe types. Export the Observable class.
languageInstructions.javascript: Use JavaScript. Observer is an object with next, error, complete methods. Export the Observable class.
languageInstructions.javascript-jsdoc: Use JavaScript with JSDoc @template annotations. Export the Observable class.

variants.typescript: Implement an `Observable<T>` class in TypeScript. Constructor takes `(observer: {next: (v: T) => void, error?: (e: Error) => void, complete?: () => void}) => (() => void)`. Include: `subscribe(observer): () => void`, `map<U>(fn: (v: T) => U): Observable<U>`, `filter(pred: (v: T) => boolean): Observable<T>`. Export Observable.
variants.javascript: Implement an `Observable` class in JavaScript. Constructor takes a subscriber function. Include subscribe, map, and filter methods. Export Observable.
variants.javascript-jsdoc: Implement an `Observable` class in JavaScript with full JSDoc. Use @template T for generics. Include subscribe, map, filter. Export Observable.

testCases.test: let received = []; const obs = new Observable(o => { o.next(1); o.next(2); o.next(3); }); obs.subscribe({next: v => received.push(v)}); console.assert(JSON.stringify(received) === '[1,2,3]', 'Should receive all values');

let received = []; const obs = new Observable(o => { o.next(1); o.next(2); }); obs.map(x => x * 2).subscribe({next: v => received.push(v)}); console.assert(JSON.stringify(received) === '[2,4]', 'Map should transform values');

let received = []; const obs = new Observable(o => { o.next(1); o.next(2); o.next(3); o.next(4); }); obs.filter(x => x % 2 === 0).subscribe({next: v => received.push(v)}); console.assert(JSON.stringify(received) === '[2,4]', 'Filter should filter values');

let count = 0; const obs = new Observable(o => { const id = setInterval(() => o.next(++count), 10); return () => clearInterval(id); }); const unsub = obs.subscribe({next: () => {}}); unsub(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 50)); const final = count; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 50)); console.assert(count === final, 'Unsubscribe should stop emissions');

performanceBenchmarks.name: chain-operators
performanceBenchmarks.code: let sum = 0; const obs = new Observable(o => { for(let i=0; i<1000; i++) o.next(i); }); obs.filter(x => x % 2 === 0).map(x => x * 2).subscribe({next: v => sum += v});
